The main takeaway from our work is that
the factorization formula for the B → ππ form factors is valid at large dipion mass, and that the form factors are dominated by the contributions of the leading-twist pion and B-meson LCDAs.
the B → ππ form factors at large dipion invariant masses are not universal and depend on the partial wave.
the B → ππ form factors are universal and can be extracted from B → ππ decays at large pion energies.
